top_signals.title: Hungary Cuts Key Interest Rate, Reviews Inflation Goal
top_signals.summary: Hungary’s central bank delivered a third consecutive interest rate cut, with policymakers set to review their inflation target after price growth eased to the lowest level in a decade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US Consumer Confidence Falls on Jobs, Business Outlook
top_signals.summary: US consumer confidence fell in August to the worst since the start of the year as the Conference Board’s gauge of confidence decreased 0.8 points to 89.4 after a downward revision to the prior month. Michael McKee breaks down the data on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
